from solution import check_element


def test_issue_example_mixed_vs_blue():
    """Mixed colors vs 'blue' is False since not all items equal given string."""
    result = check_element(["green", "orange", "black", "white"], "blue")
    assert result == False  # 0==4 -> False


def test_issue_all_equal_returns_true():
    """All items equal to given string returns True when every item matches."""
    result = check_element(["blue", "blue", "blue"], "blue")
    assert result == True  # 3==3 -> True


def test_issue_single_matching_returns_true():
    """All items equal to given string holds for one matching item."""
    result = check_element(["blue"], "blue")
    assert result == True  # 1==1 -> True


def test_issue_single_nonmatching_returns_false():
    """All items equal to given string fails for one non-matching item."""
    result = check_element(["green"], "blue")
    assert result == False  # 0==1 -> False


def test_issue_empty_list_returns_true():
    """All items equal to given string holds vacuously for empty list."""
    result = check_element([], "blue")
    assert result == True  # 0==0 -> True


def test_issue_first_item_differs_returns_false():
    """All items equal to given string fails when first item differs."""
    result = check_element(["green", "blue", "blue"], "blue")
    assert result == False  # 2==3 -> False


def test_issue_last_item_differs_returns_false():
    """All items equal to given string fails when last item differs."""
    result = check_element(["blue", "blue", "green"], "blue")
    assert result == False  # 2==3 -> False


def test_issue_case_sensitive_comparison():
    """All items equal to given string uses exact case-sensitive equality."""
    result = check_element(["blue", "Blue"], "blue")
    assert result == False  # 1==2 -> False


def test_issue_exact_match_not_substring():
    """All items equal to given string requires exact equality not substring."""
    result = check_element(["blueberry"], "blue")
    assert result == False  # 0==1 -> False


def test_issue_empty_string_element_all_match():
    """All items equal to given string holds when all empty strings match."""
    result = check_element(["", "", ""], "")
    assert result == True  # 3==3 -> True


def test_contract_returns_true_bool_identity():
    """Contract: returns True bool when all items equal given string."""
    result = check_element(["a", "a"], "a")
    assert result is True  # 2==2 -> True


def test_contract_returns_false_bool_identity():
    """Contract: returns False bool when not all items equal given string."""
    result = check_element(["a", "b"], "a")
    assert result is False  # 1==2 -> False
